scope: Public GitHub office architecture, interior design, materials, furniture, artwork, and visual identity for 3D reference. Historical phases are separate.

Search identifies 270 Brannan project; contextual site drawing only. Not evidence of GitHub's interior or dimensions.
Unverified guessed path failed. Use architect page S01 and original project galleries instead.
Mirrors office-use planning history, not a verified GitHub construction drawing set. Not used to invent measured floor geometry.
No complete, dimensioned public Brannan headquarters plan, BIM/IFC/CAD file, room finish schedule or furniture shop-drawing set was located in this search.
